title: Route 31 Stantler jumps forward between Runner chains

verification.actor: One prepared WILD Stantler (species 234) on Route 31 (map 35), with its current field/map/encounter handle and attached presentation.
verification.trigger: Let the same Stantler move under normal Wild AI until its resolved Runner chain selects HOP_FORWARD at a chain boundary.
verification.observable: The Runner removes two travel frames after every two committed Walk tiles. Its chain action starts exactly one two-tile Hop in the last committed direction, uses the current nominal Walk travel time per tile, returns control without a pause or skid, consumes the pending action, and lets the next movement chain start.

setupMutations.change: Use a disposable save, checked teleport to Route 31 map 35, native Stantler spawn, and exact-subject bind. Do not write its profile, direction, chain counter, speed, RNG, or action result.
Install the existing live actor, resolver, Walk-policy, and motion observations before boot, then retain coherent completed-frame samples for the bound Stantler.

limits: The current shared harness has no Runner HOP_FORWARD measurement or negative control. This planned scenario is not accepted runtime proof.

Before activation, review one clear Route 31 spawn tile and add a meter that binds action 7 to the same subject, committed direction, nominal speed, one two-tile terminal Hop, pending-action consumption, and the first motion of the next chain.
Prepared spawning proves Runner behavior on Route 31. It does not prove natural population selection or the temporary Route 31 encounter override.
Acceptance must reject copied observations with the wrong action, direction, duration, Hop count, subject, map, or missing next-chain start.

events.value: Prepare and bind one current Stantler on Route 31 map 35 without changing its resolved profile or movement state
Observe the Runner chain boundary and its selected action 7 on the same live subject
Observe exactly one two-tile forward Hop at the committed direction and current nominal speed, then the next chain start

stop.condition: The bound Stantler completes one HOP_FORWARD action and commits the first ordinary movement of its next chain

invariants: The resolved Runner acceleration amount is two frames
The chain action starts exactly one two-tile forward Hop
The Hop direction equals the last committed direction
The Hop duration equals twice the current nominal Walk travel time
The action is consumed before the next movement chain starts
The same current Stantler remains bound throughout the observation
